description: Assess an existing business website supplied by the caller (not lead discovery). One plain HTTP fetch (no browser) produces SEO and security-header findings, static accessibility signals, platform and marketing tags, domain mail setup (MX, SPF, DMARC), company profile, and a 0-100 website opportunity score with suggested outreach hooks. Input: url; optional business_name. Does not find prospects, contact details, or verify buying intent. $0.25 per call.
name: hubvibe_lead_qualify
title: Website opportunity assessment for a supplied URL
